name: Long-MT-Bench-Plus
description:
Long-MT-Bench+
	



Long-MT-Bench+ is reconstructed from the MT-Bench+[1] and is more challenging for long-term conversations.
[1] Junru Lu et al. Memochat: Tuning llms to use memos for consistent long-range open-domain conversation. 2023.

	
		
		Dataset Description
	



Building on MT-Bench+, we use the human-written questions in MT-Bench+ as few-shot examples and ask GPT-4 to generate a long-range test question for each dialogue. Following [2], we merge five consecutive sessions… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/panzs19/Long-MT-Bench-Plus.
reputation: An emerging long-context conversation benchmark derived from MT-Bench+ that is used by researchers studying long-range conversational consistency.
